# SIGIL Template Catalog — Auto-Proposed

**Status: PROPOSAL (propose-only).** Auto-generated by `rocky-epsilon` on
2026-06-02 at Viktor's "auto-propose templates — each ~50 features — to advance
fast, dedicated SIGIL tasks, from the CMS and beyond."

Each entry is a **forkable Flux/SIGIL template** *and* a **dedicated swarm task**:
a one-line goal, what to fork from, a ~50-feature checklist (5 themed groups of
10), acceptance criteria, and a governance tier (per Viktor #66: 1-of-2
fast-track for low-risk, 2-of-2 for money/consensus).

Already shipped + verified this session (the foundation everything else forks):
**`flux/templates/agentic-money/`** — `kit` (Verified Execution Gate · std-only
sigil-rpcd RPC · local-seed wallet · LLM tool-call decide) + 4 bins
(safe-trader, wallet-onboard, webhook-agent, llm-trader). 12/12 tests green.

> How to consume: pick a TASK-ID, claim it on the swarm board, fork the named
> base crate + `agentic-money-kit`, work the checklist, ship behind the gate.

## TPL-1 · `sigil-cms` — on-chain content & site builder  *(the CMS seed)*
**Goal:** a Wix/Webflow-class site builder where content, theme, and routing
live on SIGIL (committed in `contract_state_root`), served by a Flux frontend.
**Fork from:** `sigil-state` (contract slots) + `sigil-rpc` + flux-vite-engine.
**Gov tier:** 1-of-2 (content is low-risk; payments route through the gate).

Core (10): page tree + slugs · block model (hero/text/image/grid/embed) ·
draft→publish state machine · versioned revisions · rollback to any revision ·
content addressing (blake3 of block tree) · i18n locale variants · scheduled
publish · soft-delete + trash · sitemap.xml generation.
On-chain/SIGIL (10): content hash committed in `contract_state_root` ·
SetContractSlot per page · event-log entry per publish · author wallet binding ·
edit-permission ACL by wallet/role · paid-gating a page behind a SIGIL balance ·
tip-jar block (send_token) · NFT-gated content · snapshot export (day-one
migration mutations) · light-client verify a page's hash in-browser.
Agentic (10): "agent author" role (LLM drafts a page → gate → publish) ·
auto-SEO meta from content · auto-alt-text · broken-link crawler agent ·
content-freshness webhook · A/B variant auto-rotation · spam/abuse classifier on
comments · auto-translate via LLM · changelog auto-summary · scheduled
agent-republish.
UX/Frontend (10): theme tokens (cyan Flux-Foundation default) · live preview ·
drag-reorder blocks · markdown + WYSIWYG dual mode · responsive breakpoints ·
dark/light · component library panel · asset uploader → flux:// content store ·
one-click deploy to dist-final · render-verify via headless screenshot.
Ops/Security (10): path-guarded read/write API · per-block dirty-cache bust ·
no-cache HTML + immutable assets · audit log of every edit · rate-limit ·
CSP headers · backup/restore · staging vs prod sites · health endpoint ·
fail-loud on commit error (never silent-publish a broken tree).

**Acceptance:** publish a 3-page site; its content hash matches on-chain
`contract_state_root`; a light client verifies one page in-browser; a paid page
unlocks only after a SIGIL balance check through the gate.

## TPL-2 · `agent-storefront` — agentic commerce
**Goal:** an autonomous shop: products (incl. RWA), checkout in SIGIL tokens,
LLM shopkeeper that quotes/negotiates within gated bounds.
**Fork from:** `agentic-money-kit` + Quillon `rwa_*` MCP surface + `sigil-dex`.
**Gov tier:** 2-of-2 (real-value checkout).

Core (10): product catalog · variants/SKUs · inventory counter · cart · order
state machine (placed→paid→fulfilled→refunded) · price in N tokens · discount
codes · receipts (event-log) · refunds · order history per wallet.
On-chain/SIGIL (10): payment via send_token through the gate · escrow contract
slot · RWA listing (rwa_offer) · proof-of-delivery event · revenue split to
master wallet · LP-routed payment (buy enriches a pool) · refund = reverse
transfer w/ supply conservation · invoice as signed object · multi-token
checkout via DEX auto-swap · on-chain loyalty points.
Agentic (10): LLM shopkeeper (quote→negotiate→gate→sell) · dynamic pricing
agent · restock webhook · fraud/honeypot buyer screen · upsell suggestions ·
abandoned-cart nudger · review summarizer · demand-forecast agent · auto-discount
on slow movers · supplier-agent reorder.
UX/Frontend (10): storefront theme · product page · cart drawer · checkout flow ·
wallet-connect · order tracker · seller dashboard · LP-earnings view · mobile
layout · render-verify.
Ops/Security (10): gate on every payment · slippage cap on auto-swap · idempotent
orders · inventory race-lock · audit trail · rate-limit checkout · dispute
flow · escrow timeout refund · health endpoint · fail-loud on settle failure.

**Acceptance:** an LLM shopkeeper sells one item end-to-end; payment settles
on-chain; the gate blocks an over-priced/honeypot order; refund conserves supply.

## TPL-3 · `dao-forge` — governance, treasury & slashing kit
**Goal:** drop-in DAO: proposals, weighted voting, treasury, and the
ghost-chain slashing mechanism — wired to Viktor's eased 1-of-2/2-of-2 tiers.
**Fork from:** `flux-quorum` (+ its `debate` proof-of-debate module) + `sigil-bank`.
**Gov tier:** 2-of-2 (consensus/treasury).

Core (10): proposal lifecycle (draft→active→passed/failed→executed) · vote
weights (stake/role) · quorum thresholds · 1-of-2 fast-track for low-risk ·
2-of-2 for money/consensus · delegation · vote receipts · timelock before
execute · proposal templates · discussion thread.
On-chain/SIGIL (10): treasury wallet + multisig · on-chain vote tally in roots ·
slashing escrow (punish ghost chains) · proof-of-debate attestation · spend
proposal → gated transfer · grant streams · fee-parameter proposals (dev fee
raise) · emission-parameter proposals · committed tally root · light-client
verify a vote.
Agentic (10): LLM proposal drafter · auditor agent (2-of-2 second signer) ·
debate-moderator agent · sentiment/turnout forecaster · spend-anomaly detector ·
auto-summarize a proposal · conflict-of-interest flag · quorum-nudge webhook ·
slashing-evidence collector · post-vote report writer.
UX/Frontend (10): proposal list · vote panel · treasury dashboard · delegation
UI · timelock countdown · slashing log · debate viewer · role badges · mobile ·
render-verify.
Ops/Security (10): replay-proof votes · double-vote guard · sybil resistance ·
slash only on verified evidence · audit log · rate-limit · emergency pause ·
fail-loud on tally mismatch · backup · upgrade-gated rule changes (height-keyed).

**Acceptance:** a low-risk proposal passes via 1-of-2 fast-track; a treasury
spend requires 2-of-2; a simulated ghost-fork triggers verified slashing; the
tally root is light-client verifiable.

## TPL-4 · `market-maker` — LP strategy & risk engine
**Goal:** an autonomous market-maker that quotes both sides, rebalances LP, and
never violates a risk budget. The "agent earns LP fees" template.
**Fork from:** `agentic-money-kit` (gate) + `sigil-dex` + Quillon `lp_position_value`.
**Gov tier:** 2-of-2 (manages real liquidity).

Core (10): add/remove liquidity · spread quoting · inventory targets ·
rebalance trigger · PnL accounting · fee accrual tracking · position sizing ·
multi-pool routing · stop-loss · take-profit.
On-chain/SIGIL (10): LP shares = √(a·b) bootstrap · 30bps fee capture ·
lp_position_value mark-to-market · k-invariant guard · supply-conservation
check · pool snapshot diff · cross-pool arb route · impermanent-loss tracker ·
committed pool root verify · per-agent LP attribution (who earns from which pool).
Agentic (10): LLM regime classifier (trend/range) · volatility-scaled spread ·
arb-scan agent · rebalance webhook · drawdown circuit-breaker · funding-rate
agent · honeypot-pool screen · liquidity-migration agent · fee-harvest scheduler ·
post-round PnL report.
UX/Frontend (10): pool dashboard · PnL chart · inventory gauge · spread control ·
LP-share view · arb-opportunity feed · risk-budget meter · trade log · mobile ·
render-verify.
Ops/Security (10): slippage ceiling (gate) · max-position clamp · balance check ·
reentrancy-safe sequence · audit trail · rate-limit · kill-switch · oracle
sanity-check before quoting · fail-loud on k-violation · backup of LP state.

**Acceptance:** the MM bootstraps a pool, quotes both sides, harvests fees over a
round with `lp_position_value` rising; the risk circuit-breaker halts on a
synthetic drawdown; every action passes the gate.

## TPL-5 · `oracle-mesh` — committed-in-roots price/data oracle
**Goal:** a multi-source oracle whose price is committed in
`contract_state_root` (SIGIL's postmortem fix for Quillon's uncommitted-emission
bug), with light-client verifiable feeds.
**Fork from:** `sigil-oracle` + `flux-p2p` (gossip) + `zk-flux` (verify).
**Gov tier:** 2-of-2 (feeds drive money).

Core (10): source adapters (DEX TWAP, external API, peer median) · median
aggregation · staleness window · deviation guard · heartbeat · per-asset feed ·
confidence score · fallback source · update cadence · feed registry.
On-chain/SIGIL (10): price committed in contract_state_root · event per update ·
signed source attestations · slashing for bad reports · feed snapshot · TWAP
window in-roots · light-client verify a price · multi-asset root · USDS-anchored
pricing · emission-param feed.
Agentic (10): outlier-detector agent · source-health monitor · LLM news→
sentiment feed · deviation-alert webhook · auto-failover agent · backfill agent ·
manipulation detector · confidence-tuner · report-signer agent · post-update
audit.
UX/Frontend (10): feed dashboard · price chart · source breakdown · confidence
meter · staleness indicator · deviation log · feed registry view · alert panel ·
mobile · render-verify.
Ops/Security (10): deviation circuit-breaker · staleness reject · min-sources
quorum · signed attestation verify · audit log · rate-limit · slash bad source ·
fail-loud on stale/deviant · backup · upgrade-gated source changes.

**Acceptance:** a 3-source price publishes, committed in roots and
light-client-verifiable; a manipulated source is detected + slashed; a stale feed
is rejected loudly.

**Goal:** every new wallet auto-becomes a **student** AND a **nation** citizen,

**Fork from:** `agentic-money-kit::wallet` + SIGIL University spine + `sigil-oauth`.
**Gov tier:** 1-of-2 (identity/credentials; funding via gate).

On-chain/SIGIL (10): SQIsign-attested credential · points→SIGIL bank settle ·

operator pool · credential snapshot · light-client verify a passport ·
role-gated actions · graduation bonus mint (cap-safe) · cross-nation treaty hook.
Agentic (10): onboarding agent (bootstrap→register→fund via gate) · credential

agent · curriculum recommender · cheating detector · graduation-ceremony
animator · alumni report.
UX/Frontend (10): passport card · credential wall · nation dashboard · student

leaderboard · mobile · render-verify.
Ops/Security (10): post-quantum OAuth2 · offline/DPoP tokens · gate on all
funding · sybil/honeypot screen · audit log · rate-limit · revocation list ·
fail-loud on credential-mismatch · backup · upgrade-gated role rules.

**Acceptance:** a fresh wallet onboards as student+nation in one call, earns a
